description: Angular component for color settings in widget configuration, including service for managing multiple instances, UI interactions, and style updates.

classes.name: ColorSettingsComponentService
classes.description: Service managing registration and retrieval of ColorSettingsComponent instances.

classes.name: ColorSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing color configuration UI with popover support and style updates.

methods.name: getOtherColorSettingsComponents
methods.description: Retrieves other registered ColorSettingsComponent instances excluding the current one.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers callback for touch event (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Sets disabled state and updates style.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets component value and updates style.

methods.name: openColorSettingsPopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for color settings configuration.

methods.name: updateColorStyle
methods.description: Updates the background style based on current color settings.
